head: Amazon Prime gas discount: 20 cents a gallon on Fridays at BP until January
dek: Prime members who link an earnify account get 10 cents off a gallon at BP, Amoco and participating ampm and Thorntons stations in the US, and 20 cents on Fridays (one fill-up, up to 35 gallons) until 29 January. You switch it on once on Amazon's Fuel page or under Partner Offers in the Amazon app.
